items.title: Arab states, MWL condemn Houthi attack on Riyadh tower
items.source_excerpt: LONDON: Arab states and the Muslim World League condemned the Tuesday Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh’s financial district that injured 11 civilians, expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia. The strike hit the tower housing the headquarters of Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund in the King Abdullah Financial District, the second time the skyscraper had been struck in less than a week. Saudi Civil Defense said those injured included two Saudis, four Egyptians, three Nepalis and two Indians.
